name: Bol tile API
description: Read-only starter vocabulary of the Bol AAC app. Static JSON on GitHub Pages; no key needed.

operations.note: GitHub Pages only serves files, so building sentences, autocomplete and speech plans run in bol.js (browser or Node) or in the MCP server (mcp/server.mjs), using the same rules as the app (js/core.js).
operations.buildSentence: bol.js buildSentence(tileIds, lang) / MCP tool build_sentence
operations.autocomplete: bol.js autocomplete(text, lang, {history}) / MCP tool autocomplete
operations.speak: bol.js speak(tileIds, lang) / MCP tool speak

audioVoice: eSpeak NG (open source, robotic). The app itself speaks with the phone's voice.
symbolAttribution: Pictograms: Sergio Palao. Origin: ARASAAC (https://arasaac.org). Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Owner: Government of Aragón (Spain).
